question: Does the first executable US100 quote after a bounded daily M15 session-reopen discontinuity produce a sufficiently frequent and double-spread-positive one-hour continuation or reversion response to justify exactly one later standalone additive entry-prototype question that must subsequently face the whole six-strategy portfolio?

fixed_observer.evaluation_clock: At the first executable tick of each new US100 M15 bar.
fixed_observer.eligible_reopen: The current M15 bar open time minus the immediately previous completed M15 bar open time is from 60 through 180 minutes inclusive. Longer weekend, holiday and extended-closure gaps are excluded.
fixed_observer.gap_impulse: log(current executable mid quote / immediately previous completed M15 close).
fixed_observer.baseline: Thirty-two one-bar completed-M15 close returns ending at the previous completed bar; compute their sample standard deviation.
fixed_observer.gap_score: absolute gap impulse divided by the positive baseline standard deviation.
fixed_observer.trigger: Every eligible reopen with gap_score at least 0.75 while no observation is unresolved.
fixed_observer.horizon: Resolve at the first executable tick of the fourth subsequent US100 M15 market bar, representing one market hour without synthetic closed-market bars.
fixed_observer.overlap: At most one unresolved observation. A second eligible reopen while unresolved is an integrity fault rather than a silently skipped opportunity.
fixed_observer.entry_prices: At trigger use current ask for BUY and current bid for SELL.
fixed_observer.exit_prices: At resolution use current bid for BUY and current ask for SELL.
fixed_observer.continuation_direction: BUY after a positive gap and SELL after a negative gap.
fixed_observer.reversion_direction: SELL after a positive gap and BUY after a negative gap.
fixed_observer.observed_cost_profit: Use OrderCalcProfit at 0.01 volume with actual trigger and resolution bid/ask prices.
fixed_observer.double_spread_profit: Apply one additional trigger spread and one additional resolution spread against each direction, then call OrderCalcProfit. This is the only cost stress.
fixed_observer.eligible_reopen_day: A distinct server date containing one eligible bounded reopen evaluation after baseline warmup.
outputs: one row per resolved trigger with reopen delta, times, score, signed gap, entry/exit bid/ask, spreads, market bars held and observed/double-spread continuation/reversion USD
one summary row with eligible reopen days/events, evaluations, triggers, resolved, unresolved, rate faults, tick faults, overlap faults and profit-calculation faults
start and end US100 visible contract-spec snapshots

tester_contract.model: Every tick based on real ticks

environment_contract.origin: One physical pre-run copy of build-6140 Lab executables and cached US100 history/ticks into the family runtime; no Live or other-family runtime link.
environment_contract.required_raw_tick_scope: US100 monthly real-tick files 2022-08 through 2026-07 inclusive. The incomplete 2026-08 month is outside every fixed path and outside the invariant.
pre_outcome_freeze: source, SET, INI and EX5 manifests
required copied US100 monthly real-tick file manifests for 2022-08 through 2026-07
visible US100 digits, point, tick size/value, contract size, volume minimum/step and stops/freeze levels
per_path_gate: Tester reports 100 percent real ticks and stops normally.
Required completed-month US100 real-tick file hashes remain unchanged.
Observer start/end visible contract specifications are equal to the frozen values.
rate, tick, overlap and OrderCalcProfit faults are zero.
resolved output rows equal the summary resolved count and unresolved is at most one.
environment_contract.database_housekeeping: Generic selected-symbol, symbols database, current incomplete-month tick or derived history-cache changes alone are telemetry, not invalidation, because none is an economically consumed fixed-path raw-tick invariant.
environment_contract.single_rebuild_allowance: If a required completed-month tick hash or visible specification changes before any semantic output is read, discard the path unread, rebuild the dedicated runtime once from the frozen source cache and rerun the identical path. A second change closes the unit invalid without economic judgment.

path_metrics: eligible reopen days/events, resolved opportunities and opportunities per eligible reopen day
observed-cost net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
double-spread net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
fixed_aggregation.pooled_metrics: Concatenate the four ordered path books without compounding volume and calculate the same metrics plus path contribution shares.
fixed_aggregation.zero_profit: Neither win nor loss and excluded from profit-factor numerator and denominator while retained in opportunity count.

fixed_selection_gate.integrity: All four paths pass the environment and observer contracts.
frequency: At least 0.30 resolved opportunities per eligible reopen day pooled.
At least 0.20 resolved opportunities per eligible reopen day in at least three of four paths.
economic: One direction book has positive pooled double-spread net USD.
Its pooled double-spread profit factor is at least 1.10.
Its double-spread net is positive in at least three of four paths.
Its pooled double-spread net divided by pooled maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.50.
No one path contributes more than 70 percent of the direction's total positive-path double-spread profit.
fixed_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing direction by higher pooled double-spread net, then higher profit factor, then more positive paths, then lexicographic direction name.
fixed_selection_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later standalone additive US100 entry-prototype question for the selected direction. Unit 028 places no trade and selects no stop, hold extension, size above 0.01, portfolio priority or Live candidate. A later prototype must be identity-separated and a subsequent combination unit must retain and evaluate all six existing strategies with their opportunity count unchanged.
fixed_selection_gate.failure_action: Close with no session-reopen prototype question. Do not rescue with another gap-score threshold, gap-duration band, baseline length, horizon, weekday, direction subgroup, spread stress or period exception.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before adding source, configuration or reading any outcome.
Before any MQL change, reread the authoritative source-topology discipline and current Lab baseline declaration.
Compile corrections are allowed before any Tester path; freeze the first 0-error, 0-warning source and do not tune from compilation telemetry.
Commit and push source, configuration and compile receipt before the first path.
Run exactly four serial paths, subject only to the one environment rebuild allowance.
Do not inspect partial economic output between paths except integrity and normal-stop telemetry required to decide whether the next frozen path may run.
Do not query, alter, stop or restart Live.
